text:
chris: Heads up — I'm about to press the infra/kv v2.3.1 release but deploy-bot just rejected my attempt. I thought alex had the deploy claim for the 23:00 UTC window?

deploy-bot: deploy attempt denied — user 'chris' not in 'release-pressers' group. MFA required and role binding missing. See https://intranet/release-policies :robot_face:

chris: ah, ok. who currently has the active claim? I don't want to block the window.

maria: I'm seeing the schedule; alex claimed the earlier slot then swapped to a follow-up, but I don't see a formal handoff in the thread.

alex: sorry, i had to step OOO for a family thing and didn't finish the handoff. I can either remote in or transfer claim.

chris: if you can transfer, what's the procedure? quick checklist?

maria: we usually do a one-line handoff in #eng-releases and update the deploy-calendar entry. For role granularity we add a temporary service-account or grant 'release-pressers' via the admin console for up to 2 hours.

alex: granting via console takes a minute but requires MFA on my end. can we do a delegated sudo instead?

oncall-sre: delegated sudo is allowed for emergency fixes only per policy. For planned releases we need the proper role binding or a JIT grant.

chris: is there a way for me to get a JIT grant right now? I can request it.

maria: request JIT with reason 'press infra/kv v2.3.1 - followup window', set expiry to +2h. I'll approve if it's within the change window.

chris: requested: `JIT request submitted — id 58724`

deploy-bot: JIT request 58724 created. Approvers: maria, alex. TTL: 2h. MFA required.

maria: approved 58724. please confirm MFA code when you accept the grant. :white_check_mark:

chris: accepted the grant, MFA ok. trying the press again...

deploy-bot: deploy starting: infra/kv v2.3.1 -> prod. Canary 3 pods. Rollout id: r-2026-03-20-01

chris: running smoke checks now. quick note — we pinned migrations to 1.4 to avoid double-run. release notes snippet: "pin kv migrations=1.4; improvements to compaction; rollback safe path to v2.3.0"

alex: if anything odd, we should be ready to rollback to v2.3.0. I left the rollback playbook at /ops/runbooks/kv-rollback.md — use `kubectl rollout undo deployment/kv --to-revision=2` and then revert db migration flag.

oncall-sre: monitoring: logs look fine, latency within SLO for canary. watch the error-rate metric over the next 10m.

deploy-bot: canary passed health probes. progressing to 50% -> 100%.

chris: full rollout complete. tagging release and posting release notes now.

maria: thanks. one action item — let's add a short note to the calendar reminding to perform formal claim transfer next time (alex -> chris) before window starts.

alex: agreed. i'll update the calendar and add the post-handoff checklist.

chris: quick postmortem note — Jenkins job still outputs an extra warning about old env var `KV_LEADER_TIMEOUT`. filed ticket INF-912.

maria: noted. closing thread. :lock:
